movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.description: Just dropped and already trending everywhere — Pixar's battle against screen time is pure magic.
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.description: The dinner party comedy everyone is arguing about online — see it and pick a side.
movies.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

movies.title: Minions & Monsters
movies.description: TikTok can't get enough — chaotic, hilarious family fun that delivers endless laughs tonight.
movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.description: Pure nostalgia and wild stunts — the internet is celebrating one final wild ride.
movies.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

movies.title: Borgo
movies.description: Gripping and dark — critics are praising this intense new prison thriller.
movies.overview: Melissa is an experienced, exemplary prison guard. But a dangerous spiral is set into motion when she transfers to a Corsican jail, where she accepts help and protection from inmate Saveriu to get her bearings. Upon his release, he contacts Melissa expecting to collect.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.description: Fresh sci-fi horror that's creeping out everyone online right now.
movies.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

movies.title: The Little Sister
movies.description: Raw emotional power — the indie drama quiet night moviegoers are loving.
movies.overview: When Fatima leaves her close-knit suburban family to study philosophy in Paris, she finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and the freedom of student life in the city.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.description: Brutal and terrifying — horror fans can't stop arguing over the franchise's grossest scene.
movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

movies.title: Soulm8te
movies.description: AI nightmare meets relationship thriller — the latest horror buzz generator.
movies.overview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

movies.title: The Devil's Mouth
movies.description: Adrenaline-fueled survival horror — tense, sweaty, and shockingly brutal fun.
movies.overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
movies.description: Visually astounding — anime fans are declaring this cinematic battle an absolute masterpiece.
movies.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

movies.title: Leviticus
movies.description: A dark, twisted horror-romance that has TikTok horror creators thoroughly obsessed.
movies.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood
movies.description: Hugh Jackman's gritty take on the legend is dividing critics online.
movies.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

movies.title: Supergirl
movies.description: Divisive superhero blockbuster sparking heated debate across social media.
movies.overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
movies.description: Mind-blowing continuation with near-perfect ratings — total dream for fans.
movies.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

movies.title: 72 HOURS
movies.description: Kevin Hart's latest comedy — fast, silly, and perfect for lighthearted viewing.
movies.overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

movies.title: The Debt Collector
movies.description: High-octane crime action from Thailand that martial arts fans are raving about.
movies.overview: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

movies.title: The Dink
movies.description: Pickleball madness meets comedy — fun, light, and surprisingly entertaining tonight.
movies.overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

movies.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
movies.description: Tense true-crime thriller that keeps viewers hooked until the end.
movies.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.description: Nostalgic fantasy action — fantasy fans are debating this blockbuster reboot.
movies.overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.description: Spielberg's grand sci-fi mystery — big spectacle that has moviegoers talking.
movies.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

movies.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
movies.description: Star Wars hits the big screen with bounty-hunting action fans adore.
movies.overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

movies.title: Kraken
movies.description: Norwegian creature feature horror — giant monster mayhem in dark waters.
movies.overview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

movies.title: Scary Movie
movies.description: Wayans brothers return — nostalgic parody humor for a mindless laugh tonight.
movies.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

movies.title: Heartstopper Forever
movies.description: Devastatingly sweet — fans are crying, swooning, and posting everywhere online.
movies.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

movies.title: Exit 8
movies.description: Mind-bending Japanese horror mystery that's currently blowing minds.
movies.overview: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

movies.title: Desire
movies.description: Steamy mystery drama — looks like romance, plays like psychological thriller.
movies.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

movies.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
movies.description: Magical family fantasy adventure overflowing with catchy tunes and fun vibes.
movies.overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.description: A24 horror sensation born from internet lore that keeps you on edge.
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: The Furious
movies.description: Non-stop action choreography — martial arts purists are hailing it a triumph.
movies.overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.description: Low-budget creature chaos — so cheesy horror fans are ironically loving it.
movies.overview: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

movies.title: Enola Holmes 3
movies.description: Millie Bobby Brown returns in this charming, fast-paced detective mystery adventure.
movies.overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.description: The Blumhouse sleeper hit everyone was shocked by — thrilling to the core.
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: Blades of the Guardians
movies.description: Epic wuxia action — jaw-dropping stunts that action fans can't stop sharing.
movies.overview: Dao Ma, the "second most wanted fugitive," is entrusted by his benefactor, the chief of Mo family clan, to take on a mysterious escort mission-escorting the "most wanted fugitive" to Chang'an.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.description: Fashion-filled sequel sparking endless viral outfit debates and nostalgia online.
movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

movies.title: Little Brother
movies.description: John Cena and Eric André team up for unfiltered buddy comedy chaos.
movies.overview: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

movies.title: The Sheep Detectives
movies.description: Hugh Jackman leads a surprisingly hilarious mystery that whole families can enjoy.
movies.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

movies.title: Tuner
movies.description: Slick crime thriller — Leo Woodall shines in this tense heist story.
movies.overview: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

movies.title: Hungry
movies.description: Claustrophobic survival horror that will make your blood run cold.
movies.overview: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

movies.title: The Most Precious of Cargoes
movies.description: Devastating and beautiful — animated WWII drama hailed by international critics.
movies.overview: Once upon a time, a poor woodcutter and his wife lived in a great forest. Cold, hunger, poverty, and a war raging all around them meant their lives were very hard.  One day, the woodcutter's wife rescues a baby. A baby girl thrown from one of the many trains that constantly pass through the forest. This baby, this "most precious of cargoes", will transform the lives of the poor woodcutter's wife and her husband, as well as those whose paths the child will cross—including the man who threw her from the train. And some will try to protect her, whatever the cost. Their story will reveal the worst and the best in the hearts of men.

movies.title: Husbands in Action
movies.description: Wild Korean comedy action that delivers fast laughs and great chemistry.
movies.overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.description: Charming rom-com tearjerker — TikTok's romance lovers are swooning over this.
movies.overview: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

movies.title: Citizen Vigilante
movies.description: Gritty revenge thriller — fast-paced action for late-night movie night.
movies.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

movies.title: Your Fault: London
movies.description: Steamy YA romance drama — internet romance fans are devouring every scene.
movies.overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.description: Tense historical war thriller featuring brilliant performances from a stellar cast.
movies.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

movies.title: Deep Water
movies.description: Aaron Eckhart vs. ocean terror — thrilling B-movie creature feature fun.
movies.overview: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

movies.title: Maternal Instinct
movies.description: Chilling true-crime documentary that will leave you questioning everything tonight.
movies.overview: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

movies.title: I Am Frankelda
movies.description: Gorgeous dark stop-motion animation — a haunting, creative fantasy trip.
movies.overview: A gifted young writer in 19th-century Mexico journeys into her subconscious and comes face to face with characters from her own spooky stories.

movies.title: Saccharine
movies.description: Eerie psychological horror that slowly crawls under your skin and stays there.
movies.overview: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

movies.title: Colors of Evil: Black
movies.description: Dark European crime mystery — gritty, atmospheric, and full of twists.
movies.overview: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat II
movies.description: Brutal fatalities and martial arts chaos — martial arts fans get their fix.
movies.overview: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

movies.title: Michael
movies.description: Polarizing Michael Jackson biopic — fans and critics are locked in debate.
movies.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

movies.title: Mexico 86
movies.description: Diego Luna leads a witty, vintage political comedy-drama worth catching.
movies.overview: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

movies.title: The Marked Woman
movies.description: Dark Spanish crime thriller — tense, gritty narrative for mystery lovers.
movies.overview: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

movies.title: Seven Snipers
movies.description: Tactical action thriller — Tim Roth brings serious grit to this standoff.
movies.overview: When a former elite sniper is hunted down by the ruthless warlord who once held her captive, she must fight to the death to protect the daughter she has raised in hiding, on a remote Australian farm.

movies.title: Office Romance
movies.description: J.Lo rom-com charm — breezy, lighthearted workplace dating fun.
movies.overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

movies.title: I Swear
movies.description: Critically acclaimed historical drama — powerful, emotional, and deeply affecting.
movies.overview: Diagnosed with Tourette Syndrome at 15, John Davidson navigates his way against the odds through troubled teenage years and into adulthood, finding inspiration in the kindness of others to discover his true purpose in life.

movies.title: Is God Is
movies.description: Wild, violent revenge thriller — critics are calling it intensely captivating.
movies.overview: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

movies.title: Hokum
movies.description: Adam Scott stars in this uncanny, atmospheric Irish folk horror creepfest.
movies.overview: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

movies.title: In the Grey
movies.description: Guy Ritchie action spectacle — Cavill and Gyllenhaal team up for mayhem.
movies.overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.
